speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Venous Insufficiency leading to a Venous Stasis Ulcer.

Based on your 10-year history of unilateral leg swelling, family history, and previous DVT, the clinical picture strongly points to venous insufficiency. The wound location and chronic nature are classic for a venous stasis ulcer. I am ready to finalize this diagnosis based on the evidence provided.
